description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for Lot Nos. 23, 24, 25 and 27 of PP No. 3807 in Mattumagala, Kerawalapitiya, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha  District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including their names, lot numbers, extent, and location. The core subject matter is the compulsory acquisition of land and property, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
